name: Direct Wire (Direct Wire & Cable)
old_description: Direct Wire is a leading manufacturer of industry-best wire and cable systems and assemblies
about:
Direct Wire was founded in 1977 in a home garage in Pennsylvania. Today the company is headquartered in Denver, Pennsylvania, with additional distribution facilities in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

The company manufactures wire and cable systems and assemblies under brands such as Flex-A-Prene, Ultra-Flex, All-Flex, Veri-Flex, and Dura-Flex. Its product range includes welding cable, power cable, entertainment cable, extension cords, diesel locomotive (DLO) cable, flexible power cable for data centers, and oxygen-free copper rod and stems in 8 mm and 12.5 mm diameters produced in Lancaster. In-house capabilities cover cable assembly, color and striping (including a proprietary longitudinal striping process pioneered in 2000), inkjet and indent printing, repair and spark testing, copper recycling, private labeling, and same-day or next-day fulfillment from its Pennsylvania warehouses.

Direct Wire serves renewable energy (solar, wind, EV, battery storage), industrial and OEM, power and renewables, data centers, welding, battery, entertainment, oil and gas, mining, rental equipment, vehicle and transit, appliance and electronics, distribution, and manufacturing sectors. Reference customers include Michigan CAT, IWS Gas and Supply, and ILMO Products Company.

The company emphasizes U.S.-based manufacturing as a core differentiator, stating that domestic production yields higher quality, shorter lead times, and American jobs. Its operating philosophy centers on 'Service. Technology. People.' and is backed by an on-site quality lab that performs resistance, fault, cold-bend, mechanical, and flame testing to UL, ASTM, SAE, and MSHA standards.
